title: The Orchard of the Crescent Cove
author: Wren Crane
blurb: Xanthe Quintana, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
